title.from: Boundary: VideoML is renderer for VideoJob, not the publicity calendar
title.to: Boundary: VideoML is renderer; no VideoJob type; Publicist does not see jobs

description.from:
Parked boundary — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Boundary

VideoML is the **renderer** for VideoJob, not the publicity calendar. File this as a child on **Babulus** (not a VideoML code change).

Chattic bots claim VideoJob by state. Babulus owns the job record, Campaign, Slot, and SharePayload. VideoML does not grow Campaign/Slot types.

No VideoML implementation from this issue.
description.to:
Parked boundary — do not implement. Not a type. Not in progress.

VideoML is the renderer for Deliverable `kind=Video`. There is **no VideoJob type**. Render status is a field/state on the Deliverable. Publicist should not see jobs.

File stays on Babulus (not a VideoML code change). VideoML does not grow Campaign / Slot / Post types.

No implementation from this issue.
